title: Fix some more item lengths vs calls

notes.body:
added 3 commits
  • 633274ec...a4d6a120 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 8c834f52 - Fix some more item lengths vs calls
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10683/diffs?diff_id=685854130&start_sha=633274eceea9fd250afd475cf665b58ee9ab5985)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 8c834f528a17d8ecc7e6b99045fa999ad8eed106 succeeds
